subject: Sponsor briefing + compact demo window — VP/CTO attendance request
messages:
From: Julian Park <julian@crestline.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example
Cc: Avery Collins <avery.collins@crestline.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request for exec presence on product demo

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick connect last week — Crestline's leadership is excited to see a focused demo next week. Our CIO (Avery) and VP of Platform (myself) would like a short executive-facing minute at the start to confirm high-level fit and run through security/ops questions.

We have a hard constraint: the customer execs can only join for a 30-minute window on Wednesday 24 Apr between 10:30–12:00 PT or Thursday 25 Apr 09:00–10:00 PT. Ideally we'd have the VP/CIO for the first 12–15 minutes and then hand to the product demo team.

Could you confirm:
- whether a Redwood VP/CTO-level presence is available for either window (Wed 10:30–12:00 PT preferred)
- any pre-demo checklist you want filled (SOC 2, data residency notes, short architecture diagram)

I attached a one-page summary of the use case.

Appreciate it — happy to adjust if we can find a 15-minute pre-brief call for the CIO as well.

Best,
Julian Park
VP, Cloud Platform
Crestline Systems

Attachment: crestline_usecase_onepager.pdf (PDF, 180 KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.example
To: Julian Park <julian@crestline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request for exec presence on product demo

Julian —

Thanks for the context and the one-pager. We can cover the exec intro and security highlights in the first 15 minutes. Proposed plan:

1) Wed 24 Apr — 10:45 PT start (15-minute exec intro + Q&A)
2) 11:00 PT handoff to product demo (45 minutes)

If that works, I can block both the exec slot and the demo slot on Redwood's side.

Pre-demo asks from our side:
- Could you share a primary contact for infra questions (Avery is great — thanks)
- If possible, please confirm any outbound firewall restrictions so we can validate live API connectivity in advance

I've attached a short agenda and the SOW one-pager for your procurement team to preview. I'll also schedule a 15-minute pre-brief with our engineering lead the morning of the demo if Avery wants a quick run-through.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0163

Attachments: exec_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 42 KB), SOW_onepager.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)

From: Julian Park <julian@crestline.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.example
Cc: Avery Collins <avery.collins@crestline.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2029 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request for exec presence on product demo

Kimberly —

10:45 PT on Wed 24 Apr works for our execs. Two quick asks before we lock:

- Can we add a 15-minute pre-brief for Avery with your engineering lead on Wed 24 Apr at 09:30 PT? He prefers a quiet run-through.
- Are you able to confirm who from Redwood will cover the security slides during the exec intro? We'd like a technical person available for one or two deep-dive questions.

Also: we need a short note for procurement confirming that credentials won't be shared outside of our technical cluster during the demo. If you can add a sentence to the SOW one-pager that would speed approvals.

I'll accept the calendar invite once the times are on. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Julian

Attachment: none
